item.title: Sri Lanka bag two Gold Medals in Hangzhou
item.description: Sri Lanka won two Gold Medals on the third day of the Fourth Asian Para Games in Hangzhou, China today.

item.description: The wildlife department has reported that a total of 400 wild elephants have died this year.
